title: Bump vue-tsc from 3.3.10 to 3.3.11
intent: Dependabot dev-dependency patch bump. vue-tsc is the client type checker and does not ship: it runs in the lint-build job only. No application code, no runtime dependency, and no engine-floor change.

diff_articulation.what_changed: devDependency vue-tsc ^3.3.10 -> ^3.3.11, its lockstep @vue/language-core 3.3.10 -> 3.3.11, and a floated transitive picomatch 4.0.5 -> 4.0.7. Package count is unchanged at 431 on both sides; no package is added or removed.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: This manifest exists because the gate had been borrowing an unrelated one. Auto-discovery selected .cbsp21/patches/dep-sec-pr281-types-node.json — the manifest for PR #281's @types/node bump — which happens to declare both files this PR touches and therefore scored 100%. The gate was green on coincidence rather than on a declaration about this change. A per-PR manifest replaces that.

commands_run: Type-check ratchet is unmoved: the lint-build run for this PR reports 'vue-tsc errors: 150 | baseline ceiling: 150'. 3.3.11 produces exactly the same diagnostics as 3.3.10, so the bump neither fixes nor introduces a type error. Worth stating plainly because the ratchet sits AT its ceiling with zero headroom — a single new error would fail it.

Engine floor unaffected: reproduced nodeEngineFloor.spec.ts's dependenciesAboveTheFloor() logic over the PR lockfile — every non-optional package's engines.node is covered by a lane of the declared floor '^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0'. Zero offenders, identical to main. This PR needs no floor change (unlike #347).
Blast radius: vue-tsc is a devDependency and is invoked only by the lint-build type-check step. It is not bundled and does not reach the Railway image.
Lockfile reviewed line by line (11 +/-): only the three version/resolved/integrity triples named above. No transitive package added, removed, or re-parented.
CI observed running Node 22.23.2, which satisfies the declared floor.

files.intent: Bump the vue-tsc devDependency range to ^3.3.11.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Dev-only patch bump of the type checker. No application code, no API, no schema, no runtime dependency, no engine-floor change, and no movement in the type-check ratchet.

no_backend_no_schema: No backend API, route, schema, persistence, workflow, or build change.
